'''Cybot'''<ref name="Jedi" /> was a [[Class three droid/Legends|third-degree]]<ref name="Droids" /> [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol]] [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] that was active<ref name="Sith" /> during the [[Standard year/Legends|years]] [[5 ABY/Legends|5]]<ref name="5-Date">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' places the events of ''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Dark Forces II]]'' during the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]].</ref> and [[10 ABY/Legends|10 ABY]].<ref name="10-Date">The opening crawl of ''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Mysteries of the Sith]]'' states that the game's events take place five [[Standard year/Legends|years]] after the events of ''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Dark Forces II]]''. ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' places the events of ''Jedi Knight: Dark Forces II'' as taking place during the year [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]]. Using simple addition, ''Mysteries of the Sith'' can be determined to take place during the year [[10 ABY/Legends|10 ABY]].</ref> Cybot had [[Color/Legends|gold-colored]] plating as well as yellow and orange [[Photoreceptor/Legends|photoreceptors]]. The droid<ref name="Sith" /> stood 1.7 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] tall<ref name="Droids" /> and wielded weapons such as a [[Bryar pistol/Legends|Bryar pistol]], an [[E-11 blaster rifle/Legends|E-11 blaster rifle]], a [[carbonite gun]], and [[Thermal detonator/Legends|thermal detonators]].<ref name="Sith" />

==Behind the scenes==
Cybot first appeared in the [[1997]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Dark Forces II]]'', with the droid's sole appearance being in the game's multiplayer mode as a playable character.<ref name="Jedi" /> Cybot later appeared in ''Jedi Knight's'' [[1998]] expansion pack, ''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Mysteries of the Sith]]''.<ref name="Sith" />

''Mysteries of the Sith'' introduced "multiplayer personalities," a form of character creation that put different playable characters under different professions. Each profession under this system had its own set of starting weapons for a match. Cybot, who in ''Mysteries of the Sith'' was identified simply as "Protocol droid," was categorized as a bounty hunter.<ref name="Sith" /> Cybot's multiplayer model was based on the [[Kyle Katarn|standard player model]], but the model's texture was a modified version of the texture set used on ''Jedi Knight''{{'s}} and ''Mysteries of the Sith''{{'s}} basic protocol droid non-player character.<ref name="Jedi" /><ref name="Sith" />
